Welcome to Voat :)

What do you guys think is the minimum bankroll needed for the $2/$3 tables at the casino?

You seemed to be referring to how much to bring for one session, bankroll means how much money you have total to play poker. Whatever your bankroll is, you should only ever be willing to lose a small portion of it on any one day. At least 1,000 BB's preferably 2,000 or more. So $3k-6k+ for $2/3. But on any given session, I'd only be willing to lose up to 20% or so of it. So $600-$1,200. Ideally your long term roll would be like $10k and you'd be willing to lose $1k-$1.5k in a session before calling it quits.

Is there any books you guys could recommend solely for live poker

Most good poker books were written with live poker in mind, by live poker players. Don't put too much emphasis on tells and all of that. They aren't as important as you think.

Do you guys have any techniques to simply stop this?!

You need to stop doing that, you'll never be a winning player if that's how you respond to things not going your way. There is no silver bullet, it just takes practice and being aware of it and improving. You'll never be perfect but you can get a lot better at it. My strategy is just not to care. No matter what happens, good or bad, I don't let it bother me. I just move on to the next hand.

Please share your opinions on spanking and your experiences with it as a parent.

Depends on the child. Take me an my brother for example. My brother is a quiet thinker, while I'm an active doer. I had to be doing something at all times.

I loved getting spanked because it was quick and easy. That didn't mean that I never got spanked, but spanking was usually a lesser punishment because I tolerated it better. "time-out", You would have thought you said that someone had given me a death sentence.

I say this in every thread about this topic. Why would you ever remove a form of punishment as a possible solution? My mother had 4 sons. 2 of us needed grounded and 2 of us needed spanked. All 4 of us have developed into productive members of society.

I have a young child that doesn't communicate yet. Spanking does nothing for him as I cannot take the time to explain WHY I am spanking him and therefore if I were to do so(and have) it would be in a situation where the end result is MUCH worse than a swat on the behind. Touching a hot stove or running into the street for example.

No matter what, I think that each child is different and while some may never need to be spanked even once, there are those children who respond better to a physical punishment than to a removal of toys, timeouts, etc.

Regardless of all of this, spanking IF YOU DO SO, should be done at a time when you are not angry, upset. Spanking someone when you are angry only teaches that it's ok to lash out in anger. My parents would make us wait until they calmed down before punishing us and would explain to us why we were being punished. It actually made us feel even guiltier due to understanding why instead of just being sullen about it. Most of the time we didn't get punished more than once for the same offense.

 

 

My 0.02.
